video_title: Damian Lillard Postgame Interview | Portland Trail Blazers 118, Denver Nuggets 110 | Nov. 2, 2026

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on the team's resilience and physical play
quotes.excerpt: it was a game that we had to fight for
quotes.quote: I liked that it was a game that we had to fight for. We came out and started the game and it seemed like we couldn't make a shot. We had balls rattling in and out, got good looks and we fought a lot. They were able to get out to a lead on us but we just talked about not allowing them to pick us apart for threes. We knew we would be able to get ourselves back in the game if we stayed physical and continued to play good offense and I think overtime that paid off for us.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard on the Blazers win over Denver: I liked that it was a game that we had to fight for. We knew we would be able to get ourselves back in the game if we stayed physical and continued to play good offense.

structured.context: Damian Lillard discusses the team's resilience and physical play during their victory over the Denver Nuggets.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on reducing fouls and maintaining discipline
quotes.excerpt: there is no excuses, we are fouling
quotes.quote: A lot of the plays in the first half, they probably had a quick whistle a little bit, but a lot of them I think we just made undisciplined plays. We were in a position where it could be a no-call and we took it a step further too many times where we made it look that way or probably did foul. That is what coach said at halftime. He said there is no excuses, we are fouling. He just got that out of the way and I think in the second half we kept up our physicality but we were much more aware of the moments that we were probably too aggressive or when we reached or got undisciplined and it hurt us and I think in the second half we were more aware of it and it didn't happen as much.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard says the Blazers cleaned up their defensive discipline in the second half against Denver: We were much more aware of the moments that we were probably too aggressive or when we reached or got undisciplined.

structured.context: Damian Lillard explains the team's adjustment to reduce fouls in the second half following halftime instructions from the coaching staff.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on the team's chemistry and shared offensive responsibility
quotes.excerpt: I told him, I want you to be the horse
quotes.quote: I think he has been himself. Coming in, I told him, I want you to be the horse. We said the same thing. The type of physicality he plays with offensively, how he can get in the paint, you almost have to foul him because he is that big and that fast and that forceful. That is good offense. Guys are going to have to help. You want to be able to get into that paint to get defenses to collapse and be able to play off of that on the perimeter, spray out passes. Once he gets stopped, there was a play down the stretch tonight, he attacked and they pulled all over and I was able to catch on the run and make a shot coming off that secondary action. Him knowing for sure that we are encouraging that, you be the horse, you be on go, you get downhill, you attack. I think that is good for our team.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard is encouraging his teammate to be the horse on offense: The type of physicality he plays with offensively, how he can get in the paint, you almost have to foul him because he is that big and that fast and that forceful.

structured.context: Damian Lillard describes the offensive role and impact of a teammate who drives to the paint to create scoring opportunities.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on the team's collective investment and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: how invested everybody is from top to bottom
quotes.quote: I would say what impresses me the most is how invested everybody is from top to bottom. Usually you get on a team and it will be some guys that might not get as many minutes or feel like they should get more minutes. Everybody is fully invested in doing what their job is for the team regardless of what that looks like. You look at Chris Youngblood tonight, this dude probably didn't even know he was going to be on this trip until the day we left. We played the game early Saturday, Sunday morning before we left, he got up and he worked out with me. That is how this team is. Everybody is on point and fully invested in their role and their job to this team.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard praises the team chemistry in Portland: What impresses me the most is how invested everybody is from top to bottom. Everybody is on point and fully invested in their role and their job to this team.

structured.context: Damian Lillard praises the work ethic and commitment of his teammates, specifically highlighting Chris Youngblood's dedication.
